$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFBZ (AIP France, chart dated 2026-09-03): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart for the notes, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty.

The reporting points are in French: "location" is the name printed in the French column of the chart, copied and not translated, and "purpose" is written in French; a point whose French name could not be read has no "location". Only "spoken.en" is English: the name the English phraseology says over the radio.

notes: ULM activity: restricted to multi-axis ULM class 3.
AD prohibited for gliders.
AD likely to be covered by sea haze in few minutes.
Aerobatics NR 6683: see AIP ENR 5.5 AEM NR 9113, 9130, 9460: see AIP ENR 5.5 Parachuting NR 302, 329, 366, 376: see AIP ENR 5.5 Drone NR 40-001: see AIP ENR 5.5 Starting-up with PPR 5 min.
Low height circuits reserved to home-based ACFT at 500 ft AAL.
Pilots are advised to use VOR.
Preferred QFU 268°: due to ILS procedure.
For noise reduction purpose: route upon ATC instruction NA --> overhead TWR: 2000 ft AMSL MNM, TKOF RWY 09: maintain runway heading and climb to 1500 ft QNH as soon as possible.

The Northern left hand turn can only be made after clearance from ATC and avoid overflying the built up areas of Biarritz Anglet Bayonne, TKOF RWY 27: maintain runway heading and climb to 1500 ft QNH as soon as possible.
Northern turn must only be performed after passing the coastline, If DZ 376 active, the turn to the South must only be performed after passing the coastline.
Adhere to ATC instructions when joining departure routes after take-off and when coming from published routes to circuits.
Ground movements: After LDG, except special instruction, clear the RWY by the 2nd TWY.
Taxiways: S1 prohibited at night; S1 prohibited by day with RVR < 800 m; T1 reserved for HEL of overall length 13 m.
Use conditions of South apron: airplanes with max wingspan 15 m.

In the event of radio failure, squawk code 7600, fly overhead AD at 1500 ft AAL before entering the circuit, monitor final approach axes, momentary blinking of final approach lights is equivalent to landing clearance.
Routes Reporting points Flight altitude ACFT / HEL (AMSL) These routes are used: mandatory within CTR, in special VFR situation; in VMC on ATC instruction.
Coastal transit TW1: An explicit authorization from Biarritz ATS must be obtained before crossing RWY axis.
Failing that: direction North to South: holding over NP; direction South to North: holding over SB.

SpecialVFR: MTO minima Visibility Ceiling Arrivée / Arrival Aircraft Départ / Departure Tours de piste / RWY pattern Traffic surveillance equipment: AD equipped with a secondary radar display (see AD 1.0).
Arrival procedures: 1st contact on BIARRITZ INFO.
Aircraft bound for LFBZ must call 5 minutes before overflying entry points.
Transit procedures with BIARRITZ FIS: 1st contact on BIARRITZ INFO.
Radiocommunication failure: Sqawk 7600.
If failure occurs after entering CTR: before receiving the entry clearance in AD circuit: perform a holding If possible contact TWR 05 59 22 43 92 (emergency number only).
Failing that, exit CTR as soon as possible. after receiving traffic circuit integration clearance: proceed with landing as cleared.
AD interdit aux planeurs.
Site susceptible d'être envahi en quelques minutes par la brume de mer.

Voltige N° 6683 : voir AIP ENR 5.5 AEM N° 9113, 9130, 9460 : voir AIP ENR 5.5 Parachutage N° 302, 329, 366, 376 : voir AIP ENR 5.5 Drone N° 40-001 : voir AIP ENR 5.5 Procédures et consignes particulières Mise en route avec PPR 5 min.
Tour de piste à basse hauteur réservé aux aéronefs basés à 500 ft AAL.
L'usage du VOR est recommandé.
QFU préférentiel 268° : cause procédure ILS.
La trajectoire de rejointe des itinéraires de départ après le décollage et la trajectoire de rejointe du circuit de piste depuis les itinéraires publiés s'effectueront sur instruction du contrôle.
Voies de circulation : S1 interdit la nuit ; S1 interdit le jour par RVR < 800 m ; T1 réservé aux HEL de LHT ≤ 13 m.
Conditions d'utilisation du PRKG Sud : avions d'envergure maximale de 15 m.
